images.title: Three strips, one length
images.purpose: Show that 1/2, 2/4 and 4/8 of the same strip cover exactly the same length, so they are equivalent fractions.
images.composition: Three long paper strips of the same length stacked one above the other with wide gaps, left edges lined up, and one dashed line down the middle.
images.exact_structure: Top strip: cut into 2 equal parts, the left 1 part filled teal #0072B2. Middle strip: exactly the same length, cut into 4 equal parts, the left 2 parts filled amber #E69F00. Bottom strip: exactly the same length, cut into 8 equal parts, the left 4 parts filled reddish purple #CC79A7. All left edges line up and all right edges line up. One grey #6B7280 dashed vertical line runs through all three strips at the exact middle, where every shaded part ends. Fraction labels sit to the right of each strip. Exactly 3 strips and 1 dashed line.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
strips of different lengths, or parts within a strip that are not equal
shaded parts that do not all end exactly at the middle line
images.takeaway: 1/2, 2/4 and 4/8 are the same length, so they are equivalent fractions.
images.description: Three equal paper strips cut into 2, 4 and 8 equal parts with 1, 2 and 4 parts shaded; a dashed line at the middle shows every shaded part ends at the same place.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to run a finger down the dashed line and say that all three shaded parts stop at the same place.

image_decisions.why: Equal lengths on three strips of the same whole is a picture idea; one clean image of the three strips carries it.
